The first two staged-privacy summary projections selected nonexistent convenience fields and returned null counts, including one projection after the actual key list was visible.

A combined source regeneration, failure ingestion, staging, validation, privacy, manifest, and summary wrapper crossed its response window after writing receipts and exposed neither a final summary nor a session handle.
The first precommit manifest replay launched one Git process per staged blob, outlived two reporting windows, and remained active without an accessible result envelope.
The first combined final-builder, validator, and test projection exceeded its output budget and truncated before the complete closeout contract was visible.

The first local final-template generation treated a replacement string as regex syntax, converted a literal newline escape into source line structure, and stopped at compilation with an unterminated string before the builder could run.
